title: Optimal Size in Market Making under State-Dependent Hawkes Process
abstract: arXiv:2610.31903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study market making with a parametric model of executed volume that accounts for quote placement and state-dependent order flow. Executed volume is expressed as the product of an average order size, an exponential demand function, and a Prony-series multiplier depending on quote depth, market-order count constructed from a state-dependent Hawkes model. An approximation result for finite Prony sums on a compact state domain provides a mathematical basis for the representation. An empirical study of limit-order-book data examines the calibrated demand and intensity models, sensitivity to inventory restrictions, and the resulting placement policies. In retrospective evaluations conditional on realised order-flow paths, the selected calibration achieves higher terminal utility than a baseline while respecting the prescribed inventory bound. translated_title: 状态依赖Hawkes过程下做市的最优规模
translated_abstract: 我们研究做市问题，采用了一个考虑报价位置和状态依赖订单流的执行量参数化模型。执行量被表示为平均订单规模、指数需求函数和Prony级数乘子的乘积，该乘子取决于报价深度以及由状态依赖Hawkes模型构建的市价单数量。关于紧致状态域上有限Prony和的逼近结果为该表示提供了数学基础。基于限价订单簿数据的实证研究考察了校准后的需求模型和强度模型、对库存限制的敏感性以及由此产生的报价策略。在以已实现订单流路径为条件的回顾性评估中，所选的校准在遵守规定库存限制的同时，取得了比基准更高的终端效用。这些比较还区分了交易收入与库存控制各自的贡献。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于状态依赖Hawkes过程与Prony级数的做市执行量参数化模型，并通过限价订单簿数据的实证评估表明，校准后的报价策略能在满足库存约束下实现比基准更高的终端效用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a parametric executed-volume model for market making based on a state-dependent Hawkes process and a Prony-series representation, showing empirically that the calibrated quote placement achieves higher terminal utility than a baseline while respecting inventory constraints.
